permissionEvidence: Explore.org Terms of Service permit deep-linking and embedding and state that, when enabled, users may embed the Explore-branded player. Community Guidelines separately prohibit re-streaming or rebroadcasting live streams. ERN research therefore permits only the provider-branded player path, never stream copying/restreaming.

Current YouTube documentation supports standard iframe/IFrame Player embeds and requires player attribution/branding, unobscured controls, valid HTTP Referer identification, and minimum player size. Monterey Bay Aquarium's current official site exposes live cams and its official YouTube channel identifies the Monterey Bay, Open Sea and Jelly cams as live/current. ERN may only test the standard branded YouTube player; specific deployed playback remains unconfirmed until human review.

EarthCam's current Link to Us page says not to embed EarthCam live images and not to frame EarthCam pages. Its FAQ says embedding EarthCam live streams on a website or app requires discussing a content license with EarthCam. ERN therefore keeps public EarthCam network sources link-only unless a separate license is obtained.

NPS publicly exposes iframe embed controls for some NPS multimedia and its developer documentation supports webcam elements, including streaming cameras with additional setup. The specific Old Faithful live-webcam media page is active but does not expose a reusable public embed control in the reviewed page, and the live view credits Canon USA and Yellowstone Forever support. ERN must not infer live-webcam embed permission from general NPS multimedia embedding.

SANParks' current Terms & Conditions state that website content including video clips and images may not be reproduced, distributed, broadcast, transmitted or recorded without prior written consent. SANParks provides a copyright-permission request workflow. Current webcam pages expose delayed local video files for browser viewing, but ERN must not convert those files into direct embeds or restreams without permission.

USGS Kīlauea webcam and multimedia pages identify the livestreams as official USGS content; USGS webcam media is commonly marked Public Domain and current USGS volcano notices point to official USGS YouTube livestreams. Chamonix's current legal notice allows ordinary hyperlinks to chamonix.com but explicitly excludes sites that integrate Chamonix pages inside another website using frames. The webcam pages expose live/current views, including pages whose own implementation contains an iframe, but that does not grant third parties permission to frame the Chamonix page or reuse the underlying player. ERN therefore keeps this provider link-only unless a separate camera/player permission path is documented.

Georgia Aquarium's current webcam page offers official livestreams, but its January 14, 2026 Terms restrict copying, publishing, public display, broadcast, retransmission or other exploitation of Online Services unless specifically permitted or expressly consented to in writing. No public third-party webcam embed permission was found in the reviewed official materials. ERN therefore keeps these webcams link-only unless explicit reuse/embed permission is obtained.

The broader terms continue to prohibit unauthorized copying/reproduction outside expressly allowed uses.
